summary:
Implementation plan for Share Collections in Curate:
- Architecture and data model for public collections with Pinterest-style responsive masonry card grid
- Multi-select item flow from Inbox and Library into the collection creation modal
- Dedicated Collections management section in the main navigation
- Strict privacy snapshotting (cards only, no personal notes or user fields)
- Free account limits (max 3 collections, 50 items each) and rate limiting
- Server-rendered public landing page at /c/:id with dynamic SEO metadata and 'Allow search engines' toggle
- 'Save to my Curate' account-gated import flow with canonical URL and YouTube video ID deduplication and refetch
- Takedown contact in Terms of Service and 'Report this page' feature
- Analytics events (collection_created, collection_viewed, collection_saved, collection_cta_clicked)
- Automated verification tests for deduplication, privacy payload audits, and HTTP 410 handling
